_readme: Online PvP (M4). SET supabaseUrl AND anonKey to your project (Dashboard > Project Settings > API) or to `supabase status` for a local stack (http://<your Mac's LAN IP>:54321 for a phone). While they hold the YOUR-... placeholders the PVP button explains that online play is not set up; solo always works. See Docs/ONLINE_CLIENT.md.
